history.v1_failure: An existential search over the 95% yaw interval admitted too many ambiguous fragments; its P+R containment calculation also scored the wrong residual.
history.v2_failure: The majority-support proposal failed the exact V11 full-box unit regression before any V2 commissioning audit or runtime use.
history.v3_rationale: Yaw uncertainty can explain projected width/height mismatch, but cannot explain a hidden contact edge. Recovery is restricted to shape-only refusal and a standard two-sided 90% marginal yaw interval.

data_boundary.authorized_population: All 9,600 Stage-06 commissioning_fit camera opportunities, including detector misses and non-positive references.
data_boundary.independence_statement: The already-opened final audit is not independent validation of this adapter and is prohibited from selection.
data_boundary.audit_role: Commissioning-only deterministic robustness diagnostic; perturbation draws are not independent replicates.

adapter.name: shape-only nuisance-yaw hull admission
adapter.fallback_trigger: Only when every point-yaw refusal reason is width_mismatch or height_mismatch.
adapter.sample_rule: Uniform deterministic odd grid including mean and both endpoints.
adapter.candidate_rule: At least one candidate must pass every unchanged Stage-06 hull criterion.
adapter.selection_rule: Choose passing candidate minimizing squared log width-ratio plus squared log height-ratio; tie-break by absolute yaw displacement.
adapter.position_rule: Do not search x/y; retain timestamp-matched belief x/y.
adapter.measurement_rule: Use nuisance yaw only for analytic equivalent-position correction and frozen Stage-07 features.
adapter.heading_update: Position only; never update or publish heading.

covariance_scoring.R2C: Score Stage-07 measurement minus ground truth with R2C.
covariance_scoring.Pxy_plus_R2C: Score Stage-07 measurement minus perturbed prior with Pxy+R2C; this is the innovation covariance used by the filter.

reporting: Complete opportunity/reference/admission/refusal/recovery counts by regime, camera and spatial block.
Precision, reference-positive recall and added false admissions.
Frozen Stage-07 corrected median, RMS, p90, p95, maximum and count above 0.25 m.
R2C measurement-residual containment and Pxy+R2C innovation containment.
prohibitions: Do not change detector confidence or Stage-06 hull thresholds.
Do not fit/refit Stage-07 correction or covariance.
Do not use final-audit data for adapter selection.
Do not call perturbation rows independent samples or campaign replicates.
Do not launch the final campaign unless this V3 audit and a fresh end-to-end preflight pass.
